subject: 1093年大理国官署衙门（建筑细部待考）
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached Dali government compound map sprite. Preserve realistic gray tiles, timber, cream earth walls, empty court, gate, restrained vegetation, lighting upper left, RGBA transparent background. Redraw the entire compound with corrected rectangular plan, not a square plan. Camera is ORTHOGRAPHIC 2:1 dimetric, verticals vertical, BOTH horizontal ground axes slopes +0.5 and -0.5. The entrance-facing edge from screen LEFT ground corner to FRONT ground corner has length 14 units; edge FRONT to screen RIGHT ground corner is 11 units, ratio 14/11=1.273. This must be clear in the ground perimeter and all walls and roofs. On a 1536x1024 transparent canvas, use exactly these thin ground contact corners: LEFT (168,535), FRONT (840,871), RIGHT (1368,607), BACK (696,271). Thus from LEFT to FRONT is vector (+672,+336), from FRONT to RIGHT is (+528,-264). Front corner is visibly RIGHT of ground horizontal center, not centered. Build the gate front wall along LEFT-to-FRONT; right wall along FRONT-to-RIGHT. Leave these ground corners unobstructed, keep all buildings inside footprint and roofs complete with generous padding. The floor is a thin rhomboid earth-and-stone contact patch, not a thick base. Entire building architecture must match the new projection and rectangle; do not merely change transparent canvas. No grid lines, no guidelines, no text, no watermarks, no people, no modern items. Generate one repaired building.
negative: 文字、水印、现代元素、人物、景观背景、厚底座、旅游古城风格、裁切、透视汇聚

references.role: 返修生成输入；建筑候选为编辑目标，projection_guide为程序绘制的精确占地QA几何指导（非入库美术）

created_time_basis: 生成后记录的接收/归档时间；非工具披露的服务端调用时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面边；±3px不确定性；非3D测绘，隐藏后角未直接测得。

notes: 已逐张view_image检查原图与成品QA叠图；无文字、水印、现代物件和人物，完整RGBA透明留边；光源左上。衙门由近方底面重绘为14×11，两边投影协调。仅裁切、等比LANCZOS缩放、透明扩边；历史细部与风格仍待作者审批。
